# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security vulnerability. Use the repository's [private security advisory form](https://github.com/capynq/open-keychain/security/advisories/new) or contact the maintainer through the email listed on the maintainer's GitHub profile.

The public project is a client-side application and does not contain the hosted service implementation. Reports about dependency vulnerabilities, unsafe font handling, archive generation, the public hosted-service contract, and exported geometry are welcome. Hosted authentication and billing reports may also be sent here and will be triaged privately.

Please include whether the issue affects the local browser application, the hosted service, or both. Do not include credentials, private user data, or an unredacted production configuration in a report.

## Supported versions

Only the latest `main` branch is supported. Please include the commit, browser, operating system, and a minimal reproduction when reporting an issue.
